newsitem.title: USA: Mobil, Phillips, Falcon in deal.
newsitem.headline: Mobil, Phillips, Falcon in deal.

text.p: Mobil Exploration & Producing U.S. Inc and Phillips Petroleum Co said Thursday they signed a long-term rig contract with Falcon Drilling Co Inc to explore for oil and gas in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico.
The companies said the drill ship, Peregrine VI, will be converted from the 925-foot double hulled bulk/ore carrier, Coastal Golden.
Delivery of the converted vessel is expected in the fourth quarter of 1998.
The vessel will have a rated drilling depth of 30,000 feet with a maximum water depth capability of 3,200 meters as equipped.
Upon completion, the Peregrine VI will have the ability to store up to 350,000 barrels of liquids production in the hull during extended well test operations.
Parties to the contract have agreed to a three-year commitment with options to extend.
MEPUS and Phillips established an alliance in 1996 to jointly explore for oil and gas in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico.
The alliance holds joint interests in 123 blocks.
